config.predictor: pathology-selected logit bias ALS rank=1 regularization=0.1
config.upstream_predictor_difference: BenchPress uses rank 2; pathology matched validation selected rank 1.

selection_rule.selection_basis: release metadata and observed-score coverage only; prediction errors were not inspected
selection_rule.window_rationale: the complete calendar year 2025 is the first pathology release cohort with multiple high-coverage new models and enough strictly earlier context models

config.date_rule: earliest verified official checkpoint/model-card/repository release or primary paper date that explicitly identifies the exact model; family/checkpoint ambiguity is flagged is_proxy
config.evaluation_universe: every observed target cell is recorded; metric cells are revealed exact cells plus hidden finite predictions
config.aggregation: medians across seed-level MedAE and MedAPE
